en:
Nyufufufu. My apologies for
taking New Year's gifts every
year. I think I can buy a new
female cylinder with this.
Hm? It seems another\nrecipient for the New Year's\ngifts has arrived.
Ah, <player>! Happy New Year~!
This is what they call a New\nYear's gift, right!? Thank you!
Oh my, even for me... Is it really\nalright for me to accept this?
What!? You're giving some to\nus too?
But it's okay for me. I'm not a\nchild anymore, after all.
New Year's gifts...? And what\nwas that strange greeting from\nPeppita earlier?
Allow me to explain! These are\nall New Year's traditions that\nremain on Earth.
New Year's gifts are a tradition\nwhere adults give Fol to\nchildren.
Huh. I didn't know that existed.

That's right, this is Lavarnia's
first New Year's on the ship!
There are lots of other
customs for the New Year, too.

We did the first shrine visit and the
hanetsuki match before, didn't we? I
believe there is also a custom of flying
objects called kites.
And then there was the mochi\npounding!
Oh, that time... I think I've had\nenough of Gerel's mochi\npounding.
That's right! Shall we try using\nthe Replicator to make some\nfurisode this year as well?
Really? Furisode are so\nbeautiful and lovely, I can't\nwait!

Hmm... Clothes from the
Captain's homeland, huh?
Maybe I'd like to try wearing
one too.
I must say, New Year's is quite\na lively Event.

That is because these are all activities
to celebrate the arrival of the new
year. Many of them are associated with
good luck.

For example, dreams seen on New
Year's Eve are called first dreams, and
it is said to be lucky if you see a
beautiful mountain, a hawk, or an
eggplant!
I wonder why seeing those\nthings is lucky...?

It's probably because they make for
happy dreams! Imagine eating a
delicious eggplant while watching a
hawk fly over a beautiful mountain! I
want to have a dream like that too~.

Were you all talking about
wanting to have good dreams?
You were, right? Then I shall
give you something wonderful!
Ta-da! Behold, Welch's\nGuaranteed Good-Dream Drink!

Just one big gulp of this, and
whether it's mountain ranges
or giant birds, you can dream
of whatever you want!
Something Welch made... I have\na feeling this won't end well.
Hey! This one was made after\nfailure upon failure! So it's\nreally, really okay!
I want to try it! I'm gonna\ndream that I've become a\nsuper famous star!
Now, wait a moment! I believe\nSarah should be the one to\ndrink it!
What? M-me?!

If Sarah has a lucky first dream, it will
surely become a premonition and bring
good fortune to the Captain and
everyone else!
I highly doubt Welch's drink\nactually works...

Sheesh, you guys are tough.
But too bad! I only have
enough of this special drink for
one person.

Hmm... In that case, let's settle
this fairly with a game of
Rock-Paper-Scissors between
Peppita and Sarah!
All right! It's on, Sarah!
U-um... O-okay!
Here we go! Rock, paper,\nscissors!
Peppita & Sarah: Shoot!
Yay, yay, yay! Peppita wins!
Congratulations! This special\ndrink is all yours!
Such a shame... Sarah, you'll\nhave to try and have a good\ndream on your own...!
Y-yes. I'll do my best.
Alright, here I go! *Gulp... gulp...*
A-are you okay...?
Yeah, it's delicious!
Well, it seems she's fine for\nnow.
Hehe, I told you this one was\nsafe!
This will give me sweet dreams,\nright! I can't wait to go to\nsleep~.
Hehe. I hope you have a\nwonderful first dream of the\nyear.
...Ugh... ugh...
Oh, you're awake too, Captain.
Yes, we were worried about\nthat voice.
It sounds like it's coming from\nsomeone's room... I'm really\nconcerned. Let's go look.
Ugh... nnn...!
Peppita has been tossing and\nturning for a while now. I\nwonder if she's alright...?
Do you think Welch's drink was\nthe problem after all...?
Ugh... uuuugh...! No... stop...!
Peppita, are you okay?! Maybe\nwe should wake her up...
No... it feels like she's having a\nnightmare. Shall we check?
I can use my Succubus powers\nto enter her dream. If nothing\nis wrong, we can just leave.
You're right... I'm worried, so\nlet's go take a quick look.
We've arrived. This is the\ndream Peppita is having.
Wait, Tika. Those clothes...
Huh? Oh, what? But you're\nwearing them too, Lavarnia!\nWhy are you in a furisode...?!
What, me too?! Why is this\nhappening...?

Ah... we were talking about
furisode earlier, so maybe your
desire to wear mine
manifested. ...Sorry.
Yeah, it looks really good on\nyou, Lavarnia!
If you're going to say that, then\nyou too, Tika...
Ehehe, thanks!
Wait, no! We have to find\nPeppita instead of worrying\nabout the clothes!
Uuuugh... Number 13,236...\nNumber 13,237...
Ah, that's Peppita's voice!
Waaaaah! I love signing\nautographs, but this is way too\nmany...!
Is she... doing calligraphy?

Yes. I think it's because of
what we talked about earlier.
Memorable events often
influence one's dreams.
She doesn't look like she's\nenjoying it, so I'll go stop her.
W-what was that?
Something blocked me...
Something...?
Something that is interfering\nwith Peppita's dream.
There's something like that\nhere!?
Something like a Succubus. But\nbased on this presence, I\nbelieve it's something malicious.
Then we have to deal with it to\nsave Peppita!
Yes. However, I can't tell\nexactly where it is...
Time to make some money at\nthe start of the year~ Work,\nwork, for the sake of the Boss~
...Looks like they just told us\nwhere they are.
Mountain Fuji: Hey. There's\nsomething weird over there.
Nasumodoki: Huh? Just ignore\nit.

Nasumodoki: If we don't gather
this one's Gem power quickly,
the Boss is going to be furious
with us again.
An eggplant and a mountain...?

I think I heard that seeing
those in your first dream of
the year is a symbol of good
luck.
I'm sure they're just disguised.\nIf we defeat them, Peppita's\nnightmare should end.
All right! Let's hurry up and\nkick them out of Peppita's\ndream!
Zzz... ehehe... I did such a good\njob with the autographs... zzz.
Hehe, looks like she's having a\nnice dream. I guess we can\nbreathe a sigh of relief now.
Yeah. Well, shall we get some\nsleep too?
...Ugh... uuuugh...
...Again!?
Whose voice is that!? Let's go\nfind them, Captain.
Ugh... nnn... Wait for me...!
Now it's Sarah... but Peppita\nwas the only one who drank\nWelch's drink...
We won't figure it out just by\nthinking about it here. Let's\nenter the dream.
Sarah's dream is being\naffected by the New Year's\ncelebrations too.
It must be the work of that\nnightmare from before. It\nshould be near Sarah again.
W-wait for me!
Is that... a kite Sarah's holding?
Awaaaaah! I'm just being pulled\nalong; I don't think I'm ever\ngoing to take flight!
Um... Sarah. Are you actually\ntrying to fly using that tiny\nkite?!

She is. At this rate, she'll get
tangled in the string and trip
before she even gets off the
ground.
If we go help Sarah, the\nNightmare might show itself.\nLet's head over there for now.
Right. It would be bad if this\nactually became a reality.
Sarah! Are you okay?
Ah, Tika!
This thing is moving on its own!\nHow do I make it stop?
Can't you just let go of it?
Oh! Right!

Phew... thank you. I was
worried I'd get wrapped up in
the string and end up like a
piece of rolled chicken!
Ahaha... well, I'm just glad\nyou're okay.
Wow! You both look so\nbeautiful in your furisode!
...O-oh, thanks.
C-Captain, stop staring! We're\nnot talking about the furisode\nright now...
Sarah, did you see Nasu or\nanyone else near that kite?

No, I didn't. I saw something I'd
never seen before, and when I
tried to touch it, it just started
moving on its own...
Does that mean it was just a\nnormal dream for Sarah?
Nasumodoki: You've left\nyourself wide open!
! That thing from before!
Nasumodoki: That's my line!\nYou've got some nerve after\nwhat you did earlier.
Why did you give Peppita and\nSarah nightmares?
Mountain Fuji: Desires, fulfilled.\nGem power, overflowing!

Mountain Fuji: I'm gonna gather
as much Gem power as I can
until I'm empty, then the Boss
will praise me!
Nasumodoki: You idiot! Stop\nsaying things you don't need\nto!
So you're dream demons... Still,\ndon't you think you've gone a\nbit too far?

Nasumodoki: Look who's
talking, a Succubus! If you
keep getting in our way, we'll
start getting serious!
Zzz... zzz... If I ride a big kite... I\ncan actually fly...
Yeah, it looks like Sarah's\ndream has returned to normal...

That Nightmare from before
mentioned a "boss." That
means there should still be
more.
Then we have to defeat it... or\nelse...
Huh... I'm so slee...
Tika!
...Zzz... zzz...
Yep. It's definitely that\nNightmare from before.
Captain, let's go save Tika!
Where could Tika be? We have\nto find her quickly...
I told you, I'm not doing it!
That way! Let's hurry!
Nasumodoki: Just get to it\nalready!
I know I'm in a dream, so I'm\nnot letting you have your way\nwith me!
Besides, why on earth do I\nhave to pound Gerel mochi all\nby myself!
Mountain Fuji: Your wish... shall\nbe granted.
I didn't wish for that!
You all should just give it up.
Captain! Lavarnia!
Nasumodoki: Great, more\nnuisances have arrived.
Lady Hawk: What are you lot\ndawdling around for!
Nasumodoki: Ah, Boss! These\nguys are getting in the way.
Lady Hawk: You're telling me\nyou're struggling against a brat\nlike this!?
Nasumodoki: S-sorry!

Lady Hawk: If you keep dawdling, New
Year's night will be over! Hurry up, give
them some nightmares and take their
Crest Power!
So you're the boss of this lot.
Lady Hawk: Hmm...? A\nSuccubus is the one getting in\nour way, huh?
I'm a half-blood.

Lady Hawk: Then you know
how it works! We're stealing
Crest Power, so stop
interfering!

If you overdo it, the person
dreaming will weaken. I imagine
that would be a problem for
you too?
Lady Hawk: I couldn't care less!\nWe were summoned here, so\nwe're going to do exactly that!
Nobody summoned you!
Mountain Fuji: Wanted... good\ndream. When wish comes true,\nhuman Crest Power increases.

Nasumodoki: Exactly! That's
why we let them do whatever
they want in exchange for
taking their Crest Power!
I see...
I knew Welch's drink was a\nmistake...

Lady Hawk: Now, I'm a busy woman! If
you've got that through your heads, go
back to your merry little
mochi-pounding until you're sick of it!
As if we'd do that after hearing\nall that!
I'm sorry, but we have no\nbusiness with you. Now, leave.

Lady Hawk: Hah, look at you!
Alright, boys, let's wipe these
pests out of this dream once
and for all!

Yeah, I think it'll be okay this time.
She's probably having a wonderful
dream right now, just like Peppita and
Sarah. Come on, Captain, let's head
back.
Wait.
Um... if it's okay, I'd really like\nto spend the New Year with\nyou.
This child, could she be...?
I knew it, she's Tika from when\nshe was a child.
It's hard to imagine her being\nlike this compared to the Tika\nwe know now...

Since we defeated the
Nightmare, I think we're inside
the dream Tika was originally
supposed to have.
Um... you're going to say no,\naren't you...?
...I never said I'd refuse.
Huh, then...!
Yeah, let's play. You're okay\nwith that too, right, Captain?
Yay... thank you!

Now, what should we do?
Badminton would be fun, and I
want to go for a New Year's
shrine visit together too!

Come to think of it, you spent
New Year's with the Captain
and the others once before,
right?
Yeah, we did all sorts of things!\nLike badminton... and Gerel's\nmochi pounding.
I imagine that was quite an\nordeal.
It was... but since I was with\neveryone, I had a great time!
...Hehe, you really did enjoy\nspending New Year's with the\nCaptain and the others.

I did. That's why I told them we
absolutely had to play together
again... but then I couldn't see
them anymore.
...There were so many things I\nwanted to do.
Huh? I can do all of them? Are\nyou sure that's okay...?
I think it's fine. I'm curious to\nsee the different ways people\nspend New Year's.
Wow...! Ehehe.
Then let's start with\nbadminton!
Ah, that's right. We'll need you\nto teach us how to play.
Okay, so you use these\npaddles to hit the shuttlecock\nback and forth.
And if you drop the\nshuttlecock, you get doodles\ndrawn on your face!
In that case, I simply cannot\nafford to lose.
Yep! Okay, first, big brother will\nbe the referee.
...Hiyah!
Yay! I won, right?!
Tika is the champion. I'm truly\nimpressed by how strong she\nis.
Ehehe, that's because Crowe\ntaught me the tricks!

Hey, we've played plenty of
shuttlecock, so let's go for the
first shrine visit of the year
next!
All right. Could you show us\nthe way?
Uh-huh!
You're right. I think we're all\ngoing to have some wonderful\nfirst dreams.
Ehehe. Big brother, big sister,\nhurry up, hurry up!
*Yawn*... Morning.
Oh, Verda, listen, listen! I had a\nreally great first dream of the\nyear yesterday!
Ho, and what sort of dream\nwas it?
I was writing my signature with\na brush, and it looked amazing!
Hehehe! Looks like my special\ndrink was a huge success!

To think that something Welch
made actually had a real
effect... Hmmm, I find it hard to
believe...
Well, that's because I'm a\ngenius, beautiful girl inventor!\nSigh, my own talent scares me!
Um, I didn't drink any of the\nbeverage, but I had a nice\ndream too.
Oh! Did you have a lucky first\ndream as well!?
Ah, no. I didn't have one of\nthose.
I was riding a giant kite, flying\nfreely through the sky. It felt\nso wonderful.
Ah, I see... But that sounds like\na lovely dream in its own way!

In that case, I'll apply a First Dream
update to my information processing
mode and bring the Captain some luck
no matter what...!
Does that even count as a\nFirst Dream...?
Hehe... It seems Peppita and\nSarah have already forgotten\nthe bad parts of their dreams.
Yeah. If they don't remember, I\nthink it's better that way.
Ah! But there is one thing I\nhave to say.
Welch, please don't make any\nmore of that special drink.
Huh, why? I've already come up\nwith a plan to improve it even\nfurther!
I can't tell you why, but just\ndon't make it!
Eeeh...? F-fine. If you're that\ninsistent...
There we go.
Did you have a good dream,\nTika?
About that... I don't remember\nit at all.
Then you didn't have one. Well,\nsome days are just like that.
No, but I think I did. And it was\na good dream.
Because when I woke up, I felt\nlike something really wonderful\nhad happened!
...I'm sure you had a lovely\ndream.
How do you know?
Succubus intuition.

...Come to think of it, I don't
remember anything after
leaving Sarah's dream
yesterday.
Did you... enter my dream too?
Captain. This isn't really\nsomething to discuss.
Do you know something too,\nCaptain? I knew it, you peeked\ninto my dream!
Now, I wonder.
Honestly...
...Well, it turned out to be a fun\nNew Year's, so I guess it's\nokay.

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
